questions.ask: You say "41 of the 60 are still paying", so 19 of your first 60 families left inside two months. Does that look like a product people love? What did the 19 who left tell you, and what would the 41 who stayed do if you shut Tidy off tomorrow?

You list "Two founders" with two different backgrounds. We back one founder we would follow anywhere. Which of you is that person, and what have you done that shows you will still be pushing on this in ten years when it gets hard?
questions.quote: Two founders. One built the meal planner at a food delivery company.
